spec.description: Health of ArgoCD itself: resources, throttling, controller queues and backlog, repo-server and managed objects.

spec.title: Version
spec.description: ArgoCD version reported by the API server.

spec.title: Applications
spec.description: Applications managed by the controllers.

spec.title: ApplicationSets
spec.description: ApplicationSets reconciled by the ApplicationSet controller.

spec.title: Managed clusters
spec.description: Destination clusters registered in ArgoCD.

spec.title: Disconnected clusters
spec.description: Destination clusters whose connection status is not Successful.

spec.title: Cached resource objects
spec.description: Kubernetes objects held in the controllers' cluster cache, all destination clusters.

spec.title: Out of sync / degraded apps
spec.description: Applications not Synced, and not Healthy.

spec.title: Container restarts (1h)
spec.description: Container restarts in the ArgoCD namespace over the last hour.

spec.title: Applications per destination cluster
spec.description: Applications per destination cluster.

spec.title: Applications per controller shard
spec.description: Applications handled by each application-controller replica; an unbalanced split means one shard carries the load.

spec.title: Cached resource objects per cluster
spec.description: Kubernetes objects in the controller cache per destination cluster: drives controller memory.

spec.title: Watched API resources per cluster
spec.description: API resource types watched per destination cluster.

spec.title: Cluster events processed
spec.description: Kubernetes watch events received per destination cluster.

spec.title: Cluster cache age
spec.description: Time since the last full cluster cache resync, per destination cluster.

spec.title: CPU usage per pod
spec.description: CPU used by each ArgoCD pod; dashed lines are the per-component requests.

spec.title: Memory working set per pod
spec.description: Memory used by each ArgoCD pod; dashed lines are the per-component limits.

spec.title: CPU usage / request
spec.description: CPU used over CPU requested, per container (max across replicas). Above 100% the container bursts beyond what the scheduler reserved.

spec.expr: max by (container) (sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"}))

spec.title: Memory usage / limit
spec.description: Memory working set over memory limit, per container (max across replicas). Close to 100% means an OOM kill is near.

spec.expr: max by (container) (sum by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}) / sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"}))

spec.title: OOM kills and restarts
spec.description: OOM kill events and container restarts per pod.

spec.title: Go goroutines
spec.description: Goroutines per ArgoCD process; a steady climb points at a leak or stuck workers.

spec.title: CPU CFS throttling
spec.description: Share of CFS periods throttled, per pod. Only populated for containers with a CPU limit.

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Kubernetes client rate-limiter wait (p99)
spec.description: Time controller requests wait in the client-side QPS/burst rate limiter, per destination host: client throttling towards the managed clusters.

spec.title: Kubernetes API requests by code
spec.description: Requests sent to the managed clusters' API servers by response code; 429 is server-side throttling.

spec.title: Kubernetes API errors and retries
spec.description: Non-2xx/404 responses and client retries, per destination host.

spec.title: Workqueue depth
spec.description: Items waiting in each controller workqueue: the reconcile / sync backlog.

spec.title: Workqueue adds
spec.description: Items enqueued per second, per workqueue.

spec.title: Queue wait time (p95)
spec.description: Time an item waits in the queue before a worker picks it up. Growing wait with flat adds means the workers are saturated.

spec.title: Work duration (p95)
spec.description: Time a worker spends processing one item.

spec.title: Unfinished work / longest running processor
spec.description: Seconds of in-flight work not yet finished, and the longest-running worker, per queue: stuck workers show up here.

spec.title: Workqueue retries
spec.description: Items requeued after a failure, per queue.

spec.title: App reconcile duration (p95)
spec.description: Application reconciliation time per destination cluster.

spec.title: App reconciliations
spec.description: Application reconciliations per second, per controller shard.

spec.title: ApplicationSet reconcile duration (p95)
spec.description: ApplicationSet reconciliation time, slowest ApplicationSets.

spec.title: Pending kubectl executions
spec.description: kubectl apply/auth commands in flight per controller shard.

spec.title: Repo-server pending requests
spec.description: Manifest generation requests waiting for a repository lock, per repo: the repo-server backlog.

spec.title: Git requests
spec.description: Git fetch / ls-remote calls per second.

spec.title: Git request duration (p95)
spec.description: Git fetch / ls-remote latency.

spec.title: Git ls-remote failures
spec.description: Failed ls-remote calls per second, per revision.

spec.title: Redis request duration (p95)
spec.description: Redis cache latency per ArgoCD component.

spec.title: Redis requests
spec.description: Redis requests per second, failed ones split out.

spec.title: API server gRPC requests
spec.description: argocd-server gRPC calls per second, by status code.

spec.title: Notifications delivered
spec.description: Notifications sent per second, by service, trigger and result.

spec.title: ArgoCD / Operational
